lastCompletedStory.title: Plan-side dress rehearsal: prove the planner/auditor isolation under a codex-resolving live config

nextStoryContext:
US-010 (CAM-420) is the final story of this PRD: it closes the plan-side census (US-002 through US-009) with two things. (1) A new fixture-vs-live distinguishability test (issue AC10): a GENERIC_CLAUDE_CONFIG_PATH fixture (module-level, '[backend]
planner = "claude"
auditor = "claude"
', no [models] section) drives runPlanPhase and asserts the spawned planner argv contains DEFAULTS.planner ('opus', src/config/models.ts:62-70) and does NOT contain 'fable' (the live scripts/cam/project.toml [models].planner pin) -- a cheap, always-on positive signal, distinct from the file's pre-existing two codex-regression tests. (2) The dress rehearsal itself: a fresh git worktree off HEAD (af8f695c, the tip of US-009, BEFORE this story's own commit -- the recipe in prd.json literally uses `git worktree add <tmp> HEAD` and was run before staging/committing this story's own test edit, so the 14/16-file census it measured is the US-009 state, not the US-010 state; this is intentional and matches the story's literal recipe, not an oversight), with scripts/cam/project.toml's [backend] section perl-patched to pin BOTH planner and auditor to codex (the live config, not a tmpdir fixture), then `bun install --frozen-lockfile` (mandatory: node_modules is gitignored, audit F-04) followed by `HOME=$(mktemp -d) bun test` across the 14-path census (which resolves to 16 distinct files because two of the paths -- test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner.test.ts and test/supervisor/plan-runner.test.ts -- are physically distinct files despite the similar name, each already counted once in the recipe's own file list). MEASURED result (before/after): 197 pass / 3 fail across 200 tests in 16 files. The 3 failures are byte-for-byte the audit F-05 predicted residue, in exactly the two named files: plan-runner-codex-auth.test.ts ('AC4 - claude backend (repo default project.toml) -> codexAuthCheckFn never called' and 'absent codexAuthCheckFn + claude backend', 2 fails) and plan-runner-model-resolution.test.ts ('claude-backed dispatch (repo default project.toml) never invokes the injected cacheReader', 1 fail) -- all three fail BY DESIGN because they assert the repo DEFAULT resolves claude, which stops being true once the live project.toml itself pins codex for both phases under the rehearsal flip. Every other file in the 16-file census either carries its own injected configPath fixture (staying green regardless of the live file) or now exercises the codex auto-resolution/preflight path for real (the live [models.codex] section has no planner/auditor pins, so this also proves the cache-auto-resolution/fail-closed-abort branch of src/config/model-resolution.ts is reachable end-to-end on an unauthenticated machine, not just from a tmpdir fixture). The full recipe + measured result + rationale is persisted as a durable in-file comment (grep token 'dress-rehearsal') in test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-configpath-seam.test.ts, per patterns.md:907-909's ban on handoff.json as an evidence oracle (handoff.json rotates every story; the comment does not). The worktree was removed after measurement (git worktree remove --force). Zero src/ changes: this is a test-only story. This closes CAM-420 entirely -- there is no next story in this PRD; the supervisor's review cycle is next.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure test-only story: a new distinguishability test built on the pre-existing runPlanPhase/configPath DI seam (no new library surface), plus an in-file worktree-based dress-rehearsal measurement using git worktree/bun install/bun test (all already-used project tooling, no new external dependency).
